title: TodayWeather for Android · Shared links
scenario: Open a link.todayweather.ai link someone shared, on a phone with the native app installed. The images are the native Android screens rendered under Robolectric SDK 34 with the Seoul weather fixture for a linked place (분당구) that is not saved.

steps.title: Open a shared place
steps.instruction: Tap a shared link such as https://link.todayweather.ai/loc?lat=37.383&lon=127.119&name=분당구&view=daily. Android opens TodayWeather directly on the linked tab (here 일별날씨, Daily). The place is not added to your saved places: the bar above the tabs says 공유된 지역 · 저장되지 않음 (shared place, not saved).
steps.caption: The linked place on Daily, with 즐겨찾기 추가 (Add to favorites) above the tab bar.
steps.expected: The weather shows at once. If the place is already among your saved places (within about 1 km), that saved place opens instead and no bar appears.

steps.title: Keep the place, or leave it
steps.instruction: Tap 즐겨찾기 추가 to save the place. To leave without saving, open 즐겨찾기 (Locations) or swipe to one of your saved places.
steps.caption: After 즐겨찾기 추가 the bar is gone and the place is one of your saved places.
steps.expected: A saved place stays after the app restarts. A place you left without saving disappears; on a first launch, the start page shows again.
